item.title: P1Harmony to release 10th EP in November
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
P1Harmony is set to release its 10th EP, “Blow Up,” on Nov. 6, agency FNC Entertainment said Tuesday. With the new album, the group returns to the superhero-themed narrative it has built up since its debut, with all six members returning to carry out the final mission. item.title: Alpha Drive One’s Geonwoo seeks court ruling on contract with WakeOne
item.description:
Korea Herald • Legal / dispute
Alpha Drive One member Geonwoo has reportedly filed a lawsuit against his agency, WakeOne, asking a court to clarify his contractual status after about six months on hiatus. According to local media reports on Sunday, the suit seeks to clarify his rights and obligations under his exclusive contract, rather than necessarily terminate it. item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
Seok Matthew and Park Gunwook of Zerobaseone will return as the subunit EMP on Nov. 10, WakeOne Entertainment announced Monday.
